categoryName: Hardware, electrical & DIY — bulbs, tubelights, extension boards, batteries, hand tools, adhesives, locks, plumbing and tap bits, torches

skuLines.line: LED bulb, standard household 9W / 12W B22
skuLines.examples: Philips Ace Saver 9W B22, Wipro Garnet 9W, Syska SSK-PAG 12W, Havells Adore 12W
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; spike Jun-Jul session start and after monsoon voltage surges
skuLines.notes: THE workhorse of this lane — every hostel room, quarter and canteen. Must be BIS/CRS marked (QCO covers LED lamps). Fragile-ish in hill transit: buy in cartons, never loose. Hold deep stock — a dead bulb cannot wait 30 km.

skuLines.line: LED bulb, low-wattage & night lamp — 3W / 5W / 0.5W
skuLines.examples: Wipro Garnet 5W, Philips 3W, Orient 5W, generic 0.5W LED zero-watt plug lamp
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Night lamps for rooms with babies and for hostel dormitories after lights-out; also toilets and stairwells. Very cheap, very high attach rate.

skuLines.line: LED bulb, high-output 15W / 18W / 30W / 50W
skuLines.examples: Eveready 50W Hammer Bulb, Wipro Garnet 20W, Havells 15W, Syska 18W
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; winter months (short days) lift demand
skuLines.notes: For canteens, kitchens, corridors, dining halls, godown and open verandahs — institutional buying more than household. Eveready promotes the 50W 'Hammer' bulb for exactly this use.

skuLines.line: LED batten / tubelight — 10W 2ft and 20W 4ft
skuLines.examples: Philips Astra Line 20W, Wipro Garnet 20W batten, Havells Endura Neo 20W, Syska 18W batten
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; classroom/hostel refits at session start (Mar-Apr, Jun-Jul)
skuLines.notes: Hill-logistics constraint: long, thin, breaks in transit — needs proper cartons and careful last-mile on 30-50 km of hill road; budget 2-4% breakage. Also stock the legacy 4ft tube + choke + starter for old fittings that have not been converted.

skuLines.line: LED panel / surface downlighter / concealed ceiling light
skuLines.examples: Orient 6W-18W panel, Philips slim panel, Havells Trim round 12W, Wipro square panel
skuLines.seasonality: Renovation windows — Mar-Jun before monsoon
skuLines.notes: Orient's own listing runs ₹163-₹1,099 for panels. Slow-moving but high-ticket; carry 2-3 sizes only (6W round, 12W round, 12W square) and let the rest be indent.

skuLines.line: Decorative & festive lighting — string/serial lights, LED strip, rice lights
skuLines.examples: generic 10m serial/rice light, 5m 12V LED strip + adaptor, Wipro Next strip, curtain light set
skuLines.seasonality: Sharp peak: Gurpurab (Nov), Diwali/Bandi Chhor Divas (Oct-Nov), Vaisakhi (Apr), and every institutional function/annual day
skuLines.notes: At a Kalgidhar Trust campus the religious/institutional function calendar drives this harder than Diwali alone. Buy once, pre-monsoon; it is a dead SKU 9 months a year so do not over-order, but a stock-out in Nov sends the whole campus 30 km to Rajgarh/Solan.

skuLines.line: Rechargeable inverter LED bulb (B22, 9-12W, 4h backup)
skuLines.examples: Bajaj Inverter Lamp 9W, Wipro Garnet inverter bulb, Syska rechargeable bulb, Eveready inverter bulb
skuLines.seasonality: Peak Jul-Sep (monsoon outages) and winter storm outages
skuLines.notes: Sirmaur hill power supply drops in heavy monsoon — this is the single most defensible SKU in the lane. Fits an existing holder, so no wiring. Bajaj lists inverter lamps as a core line; the category is mainstreaming fast.

skuLines.line: Rechargeable emergency lantern / LED emergency tube
skuLines.examples: Eveready HL-52 / rechargeable lantern, Bajaj emergency light, Syska emergency LED tube, DP LED rechargeable light
skuLines.seasonality: Jul-Sep monsoon peak; also exam season (students studying through outages)
skuLines.notes: Li-ion has replaced sealed lead-acid — lighter to haul, but ship charged-state stock and rotate: an uncharged Li-ion pack sitting 12 months in a cold warehouse degrades. Do not stock CFL emergency lanterns any more.

skuLines.line: Torch — dry-cell, 2/3-cell plastic & metal body
skuLines.examples: Eveready DL63/DL64, Nippo torch, generic 3-cell aluminium LED torch
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; Jul-Sep monsoon + winter (dark by 5:30pm)
skuLines.notes: Cheap mass end, and the item that pulls the battery attach-sale. On an unlit hill campus with no streetlights on the link paths, a torch is not optional. Bundle with 2 dry cells as a single ₹99 price point.

skuLines.line: Torch — USB-rechargeable LED / hybrid / headlamp
skuLines.examples: Eveready Hybrid Torch DL142 (rechargeable + AA), Eveready Siren Torch DL102, generic Li-ion headlamp, Wipro rechargeable torch
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; peak monsoon and winter
skuLines.notes: Fastest-moving new shape in the category. The hybrid (rechargeable + falls back to AA) is purpose-built for exactly this situation — outage during a charge. Headlamps sell to maintenance staff and night duty. Eveready flags DL142 and the 100dB siren torch DL102 as 2025-26 launches.

skuLines.line: Rechargeable search light / long-range spotlight
skuLines.examples: generic 10W-30W rechargeable searchlight, Eveready spotlight, DP-7101 style
skuLines.seasonality: Monsoon and winter; security/maintenance procurement
skuLines.notes: Institutional buy — night security, generator room, animal deterrence on the campus perimeter. Two SKUs is enough.

skuLines.line: Solar lantern & solar garden/path light
skuLines.examples: generic solar path light, D.light / Sunlite solar lantern, solar wall light with motion sensor
skuLines.seasonality: Best Mar-Jun (high sun, pre-monsoon install)
skuLines.notes: Genuine fit for a hill campus with long outages, but honest caveat: monsoon cloud cover in Sirmaur makes solar-only lighting unreliable Jul-Sep, so sell it as a supplement, not a backup. Panel is fragile in transit.

skuLines.line: Study / table lamp — clip-on and rechargeable desk lamp
skuLines.examples: Philips rechargeable desk lamp, Wipro study lamp, generic clip-on gooseneck LED, Syska table lamp
skuLines.seasonality: Huge spike at admission/session start (Mar-Apr, Jun-Jul); again before board and university exams
skuLines.notes: A residential-school + university campus of this size buys study lamps in waves, not a trickle. Stock heavily 3-4 weeks before intake; a rechargeable one doubles as outage lighting so it outsells the mains-only version.

skuLines.line: Dry cell AA / AAA — carbon zinc (mass)
skuLines.examples: Eveready 1015/1012 Red, Eveready Powercell, Nippo 1050, Eveready Shakti
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Highest-frequency SKU in the lane — TV/fan remotes, wall clocks, toys, torches, hostel wall clocks. Margin is thin but footfall value is high. Shelf life 2-3 years and cells are date-coded: rotate FIFO, and cold storage actually helps. Eveready claims >53% dry-cell share, so its codes are what residents ask for by name. Battery Waste Management Rules 2022 put take-back obligations on the chain — run a collection bin.

skuLines.line: AA / AAA alkaline and lithium primary
skuLines.examples: Eveready Ultima Alkaline AA/AAA, Duracell AA 4-pack, Eveready Ultima Lithium 3115 (AA) / 3112 (AAA), Uniross alkaline
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: High-drain devices — wireless mouse, glucometer, BP monitor, digital lock, weighing scale, camera flash. Eveready markets Ultima Lithium as '15x longer lasting' and it is a 2025-26 push. Sell the upgrade explicitly to staff/office; students will still take carbon zinc.

skuLines.line: D and C cells
skuLines.examples: Eveready 950 D (Red), Nippo D, Eveready Ultima Alkaline D
skuLines.seasonality: Monsoon and winter (big torches)
skuLines.notes: Feeds the old 2/3-cell metal torches still in every quarter and the security post. Declining as Li-ion torches take over, but stocking out on D cells during an outage is unforgivable. Heavy per rupee — factor freight.

skuLines.line: 9V PP3 battery
skuLines.examples: Eveready 2666 9V, Duracell 9V, Eveready Ultima 9V alkaline
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Smoke alarms, cordless mics and PA/announcement systems (a school and university campus runs assemblies daily), multimeters, guitar pedals in the music room. Low volume, near-zero substitute — a genuine 'do without or drive 30 km' item.

skuLines.line: Coin & button cells — CR2032, CR2025, LR44/AG13, CR2016
skuLines.examples: Maxell CR2032, Panasonic CR2025, Eveready coin cells, generic AG13 card of 10
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Car/bike keys, weighing scales, calculators (every university student), wristwatches, digital thermometers, LED shoes/toys for small children, PC motherboards. Tiny, light, near-zero freight, long shelf life, best margin per rupee of stock in the whole category. Stock all four codes.

skuLines.line: Hearing-aid zinc-air cells — 675, 13, 312, 10
skuLines.examples: Rayovac 675, Duracell Activair 13, Widex/Signia branded 312, Power One 10
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Small, real, and quietly high-stakes: an elderly resident whose hearing aid dies has no alternative within 30-50 km. Zinc-air only starts discharging once the tab is pulled, so sealed shelf life is 2-3 years. Two codes (13 and 675) cover most devices; ask the campus dispensary which.

skuLines.line: Rechargeable cells & charger — NiMH AA/AAA, 18650 Li-ion
skuLines.examples: Eveready rechargeable AA + charger, Uniross rechargeable, Panasonic Eneloop, generic protected 18650 3.7V
skuLines.seasonality: Session start; monsoon
skuLines.notes: Sold as the answer to 'I keep buying cells'. 18650s replace dead packs in rechargeable torches and emergency lights — a repair sale, not a new-product sale. Li-ion is a hazmat class for road transport in quantity; keep pack sizes small and never store loose unprotected cells near metal.

skuLines.line: Power bank 10,000-20,000 mAh
skuLines.examples: Eveready Magsafe PB-31, Mi/Redmi 10000mAh, Ambrane 20000mAh, URBN 10000mAh
skuLines.seasonality: Session start; monsoon outages; travel home for holidays
skuLines.notes: On a campus with outages and 5,000 phone-carrying residents this is a staple, not an accessory. Eveready lists a MagSafe wireless PB-31 as a 2025-26 launch. BIS marking mandatory; avoid grey-market cells — a failed pack on a residential campus is a fire liability.

skuLines.line: USB wall charger — Type-C PD 20-45W, 2-port
skuLines.examples: Mi 33W, Ambrane 20W PD, boAt 20W, Portronics 45W GaN
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; heavy at session start
skuLines.notes: India's common-charger move has made 20W+ Type-C PD the default. Chargers die constantly on unstable hill voltage — this is a repeat-purchase line, not one-off. Stock BIS-marked only; a cheap adaptor failing in a hostel is the one product that can burn a dormitory.

skuLines.line: Charging & data cables — C-to-C, A-to-C, micro-USB, lightning
skuLines.examples: boAt Type-C 1m, Ambrane braided C-to-C, Mi USB-C, generic micro-USB
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Highest-velocity accessory in the lane after dry cells, and the best margin among the electrical items. Type-C is now the volume SKU; keep micro-USB for older handsets and Bluetooth speakers, and 2-3 lightning for iPhone-carrying staff. Braided sells at 2x plain and lasts — push it.

skuLines.line: Extension board / spike guard — 4-6 socket, surge + USB
skuLines.examples: Anchor Penta 4-way, Goldmedal spike guard, Havells 6-socket surge, Bajaj extension board, GM 4+1 with USB
skuLines.seasonality: Big spike at session start; year-round baseline
skuLines.notes: Hostel rooms have 1-2 sockets and 4 students with phones, laptops and study lamps — this is a certainty, not a guess. Insist on BIS-marked, real surge protection and 6A/16A rating; the ₹99 unbranded board is the classic hostel fire cause. Boards with built-in Type-C PD are the 2026 shape.

skuLines.line: Extension cord (3-5 m lead), 3-way multiplug, universal travel adaptor
skuLines.examples: Anchor 3-pin extension cord 5m, generic 3-way multiplug, Belkin/GM universal adaptor
skuLines.seasonality: Session start; function/event season (Nov, Apr)
skuLines.notes: Long leads sell to canteens, functions and quarters where the socket is nowhere near the appliance. Multiplugs are the cheap impulse SKU; sell the fused one and refuse the 6-way unfused block.

skuLines.line: Plug tops & converters — 6A / 16A, 3-pin↔2-pin
skuLines.examples: Anchor Penta 6A plug top, Anchor 16A plug top, GM 3-pin to 2-pin converter
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Pure repair consumable — a cut cord on an iron, kettle or immersion rod. Cheap, light, always sells, and the customer is already in the shop with a broken appliance. Stock both 6A and 16A (immersion rods and heaters need 16A).

skuLines.line: Lamp holders — batten, angle, pendant + ceiling rose
skuLines.examples: Anchor batten holder B22, Anchor angle holder, Anchor pendant holder, Anchor ceiling rose
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Holders crack and carbonise; a burnt holder is why the 'new bulb also doesn't work'. Bakelite holders are the mass item, porcelain/heat-resistant for high-wattage canteen and kitchen fittings.

skuLines.line: Modular switches, sockets, plates, PVC boxes + doorbell/bell push
skuLines.examples: Anchor Roma 6A switch, Anchor Penta modular socket, Legrand Mylinc, GM plate + metal box, Anchor bell push, wireless chime
skuLines.seasonality: Renovation window Mar-Jun; year-round breakage
skuLines.notes: Anchor by Panasonic and Goldmedal are the names asked for. Stock ONE modular system's plates and modules — mixing brands means a resident's plate never fits your module and you eat the stock. Bell pushes and wireless chimes sell to staff quarters.

skuLines.line: House wire, cut-to-length — 1.0 / 1.5 / 2.5 sq mm + 3-core flexible cord
skuLines.examples: Polycab FR 1.5sqmm, Havells Life Line 1.0, Finolex FR 2.5, generic 3-core 0.75 flexible cord
skuLines.packSizes: cut by the metre; 90m coils for institutional
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Jun refits; post-monsoon rewiring of damp circuits
skuLines.notes: Cut-to-length is the service that makes this line work — a resident wants 4 metres, not a 90m coil. Must be FR-grade and BIS marked (QCO on house wiring cables). Copper price moves weekly, so re-price coils on every inward; do not sit on old-cost stock in a rising market or vice versa.

skuLines.line: Electrical consumables — insulation/PVC tape, wire connectors, cable ties, fuse wire
skuLines.examples: Steelgrip PVC tape, Anchor insulation tape, generic connector strip 6A/16A, nylon cable ties 4in/8in, 15A fuse wire card
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; pre-monsoon (May-Jun) taping of damp joints
skuLines.notes: Steelgrip is Pidilite's tape brand and is what people name. Highest-turn cheap consumable in the electrical half — keep it at the counter. Tape adhesive hardens in cold storage; do not hold more than 6 months of cover in an unheated hill godown.

skuLines.line: MCB, RCCB, DB spares & voltage stabilizer
skuLines.examples: Havells 16A/32A MCB, Anchor MCB, Havells RCCB 25A, V-Guard/Microtek stabilizer for TV & fridge
skuLines.seasonality: Monsoon (Jul-Sep) surge and trip season; winter heater load Nov-Feb
skuLines.notes: Hill supply means real voltage swing — stabilizers protect fridges and TVs in staff quarters and sell steadily. Winter heater load trips MCBs, so keep 16A and 32A deep from October. BIS marked only; a fake MCB is a non-functional MCB.

skuLines.line: Appliance & fitting spares — fan regulator, capacitor, geyser element, iron cord, mixer coupler
skuLines.examples: Anchor step-type fan regulator, 2.5µF fan capacitor, 2000W geyser element, 3-pin iron cord, Bajaj/Preethi mixer coupler
skuLines.priceBand: regulator ₹80-350; capacitor ₹60-200; geyser element ₹250-900; iron cord ₹120-350; coupler ₹30-120
skuLines.seasonality: Geyser elements Sep-Nov (pre-winter) and Feb; fan parts Apr-Jun
skuLines.notes: The repair economy is the whole point of a captive campus: nobody drives 30 km to replace a ₹120 capacitor, they either fix it here or live without a fan. High margin, small footprint, and it makes the store the place people come to first. Geyser element specs vary — note the wattage and tank brand at the counter.

skuLines.line: Immersion water-heating rod (1000-1500W, ISI)
skuLines.examples: Bajaj immersion rod 1500W, Crompton immersion heater, Havells water heating rod, Eveready rod
skuLines.seasonality: Very sharp Oct-Feb; near-zero Apr-Aug
skuLines.notes: In Rajgarh's winter this is the highest-conviction seasonal SKU in the whole lane — hostels and quarters without geysers heat buckets. ISI mark is mandatory and non-negotiable (bucket + 1500W + student = the exact scenario the standard exists for). Pre-book and land stock by end-September; it will not arrive on schedule in December.

skuLines.line: Room heater — halogen / fan blower / oil-filled radiator
skuLines.examples: Bajaj Blow Hot, Orpat OEH-1220 halogen, Havells fan heater, Usha oil-filled radiator
skuLines.seasonality: Oct-Feb only, peak Nov-Dec
skuLines.notes: Married staff quarters with small children and babies, and elderly residents, are the buyers — this is a health item at that altitude, not a comfort item. Bulky and expensive: hold the halogen/blower end in the warehouse, and take the oil-filled radiator on indent with a deposit. Land it before the first cold snap; a December order will not make it.

skuLines.line: Screwdriver set + neon line tester
skuLines.examples: Taparia 840 screwdriver set, Stanley 6-pc set, Taparia line tester, generic 32-in-1 precision kit
skuLines.seasonality: Session start; year-round
skuLines.notes: The line tester is the single most-asked hardware item in an Indian home ('is there current?'). Precision 32-in-1 kits sell to university students opening laptops and phones. Snapdeal's own tools listings show 32-in-1 and 40-in-1 kits as the volume shapes.

skuLines.line: Pliers, wire cutter/stripper, adjustable spanner
skuLines.examples: Taparia 1621-8 combination plier, Taparia nose plier, Taparia 1171 adjustable spanner, Stanley wire stripper
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Taparia is the name Indian buyers trust in hand tools and it prices in this band. 8-inch insulated combination plier is the one SKU you cannot be out of. Slow-turning but near-zero spoilage — ideal warehouse stock for a remote store.

skuLines.line: Hammer, hacksaw frame + blades, chisel, file
skuLines.examples: Taparia claw hammer 340g, Stanley ball-pein hammer, generic 12in hacksaw frame + Eastman blades, Taparia flat file
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; pre-monsoon repair season May-Jun
skuLines.notes: Hacksaw blades are the consumable that repeats — stock them 10-deep even if you sell one frame a quarter. Steel tools rust in hill monsoon humidity: oil-wipe on inward and keep off the floor in an unheated godown.

skuLines.line: Measuring tape, spirit level, allen key set, utility knife + blades
skuLines.examples: Freemans 3m/5m steel tape, Taparia allen key set 9-pc, generic 300mm spirit level, Kangaro/generic snap-off cutter + blade packs
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; allen keys spike at session start (furniture assembly)
skuLines.notes: Allen keys are the hostel furniture SKU — every flat-pack bed, table and rack on campus needs one and they all go missing. Snap-off knife blades are a fast, high-margin consumable for students and the store's own packing bench.

skuLines.line: Home tool kit in a box (25-100 pc)
skuLines.examples: Cheston 100-pc kit, Bosch home kit, Taparia home tool kit, Stanley 25-pc
skuLines.seasonality: Session start / new-quarter allotment; Diwali gifting
skuLines.notes: The natural buy for a staff family moving into a quarter — one purchase covers screwdriver, plier, hammer, tape, allen keys. Also a real gifting SKU in Oct-Nov. Two price points (₹599 and ₹1,499) is enough; the boxes are bulky.

skuLines.line: Cordless drill / driver + masonry & HSS bit set
skuLines.examples: Cheston CHD-12V, Bosch GSB 500W impact drill, Black+Decker 12V, generic 13-pc masonry bit set
skuLines.seasonality: Renovation window Mar-Jun
skuLines.notes: Buyer is campus maintenance and a handful of DIY staff, not residents. Better run as a tool-lending/deposit service than as inventory — one or two units on the shelf, bits and wall plugs stocked deep because those are the repeat consumable.

skuLines.line: Loose fasteners — wire nails, screws, wall plugs (gitti), nut-bolts, washers
skuLines.examples: assorted wire nails 1in-4in, self-tapping screws 6x1in / 8x2in, 6mm & 8mm nylon wall plugs, MS nut-bolt assortment
skuLines.packSizes: sold loose by 100g/250g/kg and in 10/50-piece polybags
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; Mar-Jun renovation peak
skuLines.marginBand: 45-65% (highest in the lane on loose sale)
skuLines.notes: Loose-sale fasteners are the classic hardware profit engine: bought by weight, sold by the handful. Nobody drives 30 km for six screws, so ARY owns this demand absolutely. Needs a weighing scale, small polybags and labelled bins — that operational discipline IS the SKU. Rust risk in monsoon: keep in sealed containers with silica.

skuLines.line: Hooks, curtain rods & brackets, clothesline wire/rope, clips
skuLines.examples: 3M Command adhesive hooks, generic S-hooks and screw hooks, 4ft/6ft curtain rod + brackets, PVC-coated clothesline wire 10m, plastic clips 24-pack
skuLines.packSizes: blister of 2-6 hooks; rods single; wire by 10m/20m; clips 24/48
skuLines.seasonality: Session start peak; clothesline demand rises Jul-Sep (nothing dries in monsoon) and again in winter
skuLines.notes: Everyone in a hostel room hangs something and cannot drill a wall — adhesive hooks are the answer and they are pure margin. Clothesline wire and clips are a genuine monsoon must in a place where washing takes days to dry; stock indoor drying line too.

skuLines.line: Padlocks — brass/steel 32-65 mm, standard and long shackle, + cycle lock
skuLines.examples: Godrej Ultra brass padlock 50mm, Harrison 65mm, Link brass lock, generic long-shackle 50mm, cycle chain lock
skuLines.seasonality: Very sharp spike at admission/session start (Mar-Apr, Jun-Jul); steady trickle year-round on lost keys
skuLines.notes: Non-negotiable for a residential school and university: every student locks a trunk, a locker and a room. Godrej and Harrison are the names asked for. Stock at least three sizes and deep at intake. Brass resists hill monsoon corrosion far better than plated steel — recommend brass and say why. Pair with a key-cutting service.

skuLines.line: Number / combination locks & luggage locks
skuLines.examples: Godrej combination lock, generic 4-digit dial padlock, TSA luggage lock, cable combination lock
skuLines.seasonality: Admission intake and every holiday departure/return (a lost key 30 km from a locksmith is the pain point)
skuLines.notes: The keyless answer to the campus's real problem: children aged 5-18 lose keys constantly and there is no locksmith nearby. Push combination locks for junior hostel lockers on that argument alone.

skuLines.line: Furniture locks — almirah, cupboard, drawer, multipurpose
skuLines.examples: Godrej almirah lock, Godrej multipurpose lock, Harrison cupboard lock, drawer/desk lock
skuLines.seasonality: Session start; year-round replacement
skuLines.notes: Steel almirahs in hostels and quarters have failing locks. Godrej-pattern replacements are what fit. Note the almirah brand and lock hand (left/right) at the counter before selling — a wrong-hand lock is a guaranteed return.

skuLines.line: Door hardware — aldrop, tower bolt, hasp & staple, hinges, night latch, handle/mortise lock, door closer, door stopper
skuLines.examples: Godrej mortise handle set, Harrison aldrop 10in, generic SS tower bolt 6in, brass butt hinges 3in, night latch, hydraulic door closer
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Jun renovation; post-monsoon (swollen doors, seized latches)
skuLines.notes: Hill monsoon swells wooden doors and rusts fittings — post-monsoon is a real repair season for latches and hinges. Stainless steel over plated MS for this climate; say so and charge for it. Door closers sell to institutional buildings, not homes.

skuLines.line: White wood / general adhesive — synthetic resin (Fevicol SH type)
skuLines.examples: Fevicol SH 50g/125g/500g, Fevicol Marine, Araldite wood glue
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; school-project peaks and Mar-Jun repair season
skuLines.notes: Fevicol is the generic name for glue in India — carry it or lose credibility. Small packs move to students for projects, large packs to carpentry/maintenance. Water-based: it FREEZES and separates below ~4°C, a real risk in an unheated Sirmaur godown in December — store inside, not in the warehouse.

skuLines.line: Instant adhesive & glue stick — cyanoacrylate, glue stick
skuLines.examples: Fevikwik 0.5g sachet, Fevikwik 3g tube, Fevistik glue stick 8g/15g, generic super glue
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; heavy at exam/project season
skuLines.notes: The ₹5-10 Fevikwik sachet strip is one of the highest-unit-velocity items a general store carries — spectacles, chappals, toys, phone cases. Fevistik is the school-project sibling. Short-ish shelf life on cyanoacrylate (12-18 months) and it cures in humidity: buy small and often, do not stockpile.

skuLines.line: Epoxy putty & 2-part epoxy adhesive
skuLines.examples: M-Seal Phataphat, M-Seal regular 100g, Araldite Standard/Rapid twin tube, generic steel epoxy
skuLines.seasonality: Sharp pre-monsoon and monsoon peak (May-Sep) — leaks, cracked pipes, dripping taps
skuLines.notes: M-Seal is the leaking-tap and cracked-tank fix and the name everyone uses. Genuinely a hill-monsoon hero SKU: a resident with a leak has no plumber on call and no shop 30 km away. Stock deep from April. Both parts harden if stored warm — but here the risk is the opposite: keep above freezing.

skuLines.line: Silicone sealant + gun, rubber solution
skuLines.examples: Dr. Fixit silicone sealant, Wacker/generic clear silicone cartridge, caulking gun, Fevibond/rubber solution 50ml
skuLines.seasonality: Pre-monsoon Apr-Jun (sealing windows, roof joints, bathroom edges)
skuLines.notes: Sells with the waterproofing line as a pre-monsoon bundle. Needs the gun as an attach-sale — stock both or the cartridge is useless. Cartridge shelf life 12-18 months; date-check on inward.

skuLines.line: Tapes — duct/cloth, masking, double-sided, waterproof leak-seal
skuLines.examples: generic duct tape 2in, 3M masking tape, 3M/generic double-sided foam tape, Fevicol/Dr Fixit leak-seal tape
skuLines.seasonality: Pre-monsoon and monsoon peak (May-Sep); painting season for masking tape
skuLines.notes: Duct tape and leak-seal tape are what people reach for first in a hill monsoon — sealing a dripping window, a torn tarpaulin, a cracked drainpipe. Wide, high margin, light freight. Adhesive stiffens in cold — do not carry more than two seasons of cover.

skuLines.line: Lubricant & rust spray — WD-40, machine oil, grease
skuLines.examples: WD-40 multi-use 63ml/191ml/277ml, generic 3-in-1 oil can, lithium grease tub, chain lube
skuLines.seasonality: Peak Sep-Nov (post-monsoon rust) and year-round for cycles/gates
skuLines.notes: Pidilite distributes WD-40 in India, so it comes through the same channel as Fevicol. Post-monsoon Sirmaur means seized hinges, rusted padlocks, stuck bolts and stiff cycle chains everywhere — this is a seasonal certainty. Aerosols are pressurised: flammable-goods handling in road transport and keep out of a hot vehicle.

skuLines.line: Waterproofing & leak repair, small packs
skuLines.examples: Dr. Fixit LW+ 100ml/500ml, Dr. Fixit Roofseal, Dr. Fixit crack-fill paste, generic bitumen sealant
skuLines.seasonality: Very sharp Apr-Jun (pre-monsoon) then panic buying Jul-Sep
skuLines.notes: Heavy monsoon in Sirmaur makes seepage the number-one household complaint in quarters. Dr. Fixit is the branded answer and comes through the Pidilite channel. Small consumer packs only — the 20kg contractor packs are the campus works department's problem, not the store's. Water-based: protect from freezing.

skuLines.line: Tarpaulin sheet + nylon rope / clothesline wire
skuLines.examples: HDPE tarpaulin 6x9ft / 9x12ft / 12x15ft, nylon rope 6mm by the metre, PVC-coated wire rope
skuLines.packSizes: folded sheets by size; rope cut by the metre or 20m hanks
skuLines.seasonality: Pre-monsoon May-Jun, and again in the first heavy spell
skuLines.notes: In a heavy-monsoon hill location a tarpaulin is what covers a leaking roof, a stack of firewood, a parked scooter or goods in transit. Bulky but light, cheap to hold, and it sells out the week the rain starts — buy in May, not July. Cut-to-length rope is a margin service.

skuLines.line: Taps & bib cocks 15mm, angle valve, PTFE tape, tap washers & gaskets
skuLines.examples: Jaquar/Cera 15mm bib cock, Prayag PVC bib cock, generic brass angle valve, PTFE/teflon tape 12mm, rubber tap washer assortment
skuLines.packSizes: single taps/valves; PTFE single rolls; washers in packs of 10
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; winter peak (Nov-Feb) — frozen/burst joints and dripping taps in cold quarters
skuLines.notes: A dripping tap in a place with no plumber and no shop is exactly the leak ARY should be closing. PTFE tape and a 10-pack of rubber washers is the ₹30 fix that saves a ₹700 tap sale — carry both. Stock PVC (cheap) and brass/CP (staff quarters) ends. Cold-climate note: keep a few extra 15mm bib cocks from November, burst-joint season.

skuLines.line: Health faucet / jet spray, shower rose, flexible hose + clamps
skuLines.examples: Jaquar health faucet, generic ABS jet spray with 1m hose, Cera overhead shower 4in, washing-machine inlet hose, SS hose clamps
skuLines.packSizes: single; clamps loose or in packs of 10
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; renovation window Mar-Jun
skuLines.notes: Health faucets and their hoses fail constantly (the hose splits first) — stock the hose separately, not only the full set, because that is the actual repeat purchase. Hose clamps are a cheap loose-sale item with excellent margin.

skuLines.line: PVC/CPVC pipe & fittings (small dia), solvent cement, waste coupling, bottle trap, drain jali, plunger
skuLines.examples: Astral/Supreme 1/2in & 3/4in CPVC elbow-tee-coupler, Astral solvent cement 50ml/100ml, PVC waste pipe 32mm, bottle trap, SS drain jali 5in, rubber plunger
skuLines.packSizes: fittings single/loose; pipe cut to length; cement 50ml/100ml/200ml
skuLines.seasonality: Winter (burst joints) and monsoon (blocked drains); Mar-Jun renovation
skuLines.notes: Fittings are the loose-sale margin engine of the plumbing half — elbows, tees, couplers, reducers in 1/2in and 3/4in cover 80% of asks. Sell pipe cut-to-length. Solvent cement is flammable and has a ~12-month shelf life once the tin is opened; small packs only. Add cistern spares here — ball cock, float valve, flush kit (₹120-600).

skuLines.line: LPG ISI suraksha hose, gas lighter, burner spares
skuLines.examples: ISI-marked LPG suraksha hose 1.5m, generic gas lighter, brass burner, pan support
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; hose replacement drives cluster around safety inspections
skuLines.notes: Only sell ISI-marked LPG hose — it is a safety-standard item with a stamped expiry, and a non-ISI hose in a residential campus kitchen is an unacceptable risk. Gas lighters are a high-velocity, high-margin impulse item. Note: LPG regulators are oil-company property and cannot be retailed; do not stock them.

skuLines.line: Paint & finishing small packs — enamel, brush, sandpaper, wall putty
skuLines.examples: Asian Paints Apcolite enamel 100ml/500ml, Nerolac synthetic enamel, 1in/2in paint brushes, emery/sandpaper sheets 80-400 grit, JK wall putty 1kg
skuLines.packSizes: 100ml / 200ml / 500ml enamel; brushes single; sandpaper by sheet; putty 1kg/5kg
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Jun pre-monsoon painting; pre-festival touch-ups Oct
skuLines.notes: Small touch-up packs only — grille, gate, window and furniture repaint in staff quarters. The full decorative-paint business belongs to a paint dealer, not this store. Brushes and sandpaper carry the margin. Solvent-based enamel is flammable for road transport; keep quantities small.

skuLines.line: Smoke alarm, fire extinguisher & basic safety wear
skuLines.examples: generic 9V smoke alarm, 1kg/2kg ABC dry-powder extinguisher, cotton work gloves, electrician's rubber gloves, dust mask, safety goggles
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; winter (heater season) is the honest time to push smoke alarms
skuLines.notes: Institutional buyer — hostel wardens, kitchen, generator room, works department. A residential school running immersion rods and room heaters through a Himachal winter has a real fire-risk profile, so this belongs on the shelf even at low turn. Extinguishers need periodic refilling — that is a service, see adjacent services.

trends2026: BIS/QCO enforcement has widened across LED lamps, LED drivers, switches, sockets, plug tops and house wiring cables — unmarked cheap imports are being pulled from shelves, so a retailer must now buy BIS/CRS-marked stock only. Practically: the ₹99 no-name spike guard and the unmarked immersion rod are becoming un-stockable, and the price floor of the category is rising.

3CCT / selectable-white LED bulbs and battens (warm / neutral / cool from one lamp) have become the mainstream ₹150-250 price point rather than a premium feature — Orient, Havells, Wipro and Philips all lead their consumer lighting ranges with 3CCT now.

Rechargeable 'inverter bulbs' and Li-ion emergency battens have replaced the old CFL emergency lantern as the default power-cut answer. They fit an existing B22 holder, need no wiring, and sit at ₹280-750 — which is why they are spreading fast into small-town and hill retail.

USB Type-C has become the de-facto single charging standard in India, and the fast-moving accessory SKUs are now 20-45W Type-C PD adaptors, C-to-C cables and extension boards with built-in USB-C PD sockets. Micro-USB is shrinking to a legacy tail.

Li-ion / USB-rechargeable torches and headlamps are displacing D-cell metal torches, and hybrid designs that run on EITHER the internal pack or ordinary AA cells (e.g. Eveready's DL142, launched as 'India's first hybrid torch') are the new shape — built precisely for the outage-during-a-charge problem.

Alkaline and lithium primary cells are growing share against carbon-zinc as household devices get more high-drain (glucometers, BP monitors, wireless mice, digital locks); Eveready's Ultima Lithium ('15x longer lasting') is a current push, and coin cells (CR2032/LR44) are quietly the best-margin battery line in retail.

Q-commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart) has turned bulbs, batteries, extension boards, Fevikwik and M-Seal into 10-minute categories in Indian cities. This resets the expectation that a hardware need is met immediately — which is exactly the expectation a captive campus store either meets or loses the trip to town over.

Battery Waste Management Rules 2022 and e-waste EPR obligations are reaching the retail counter: take-back and collection of used cells and dead LED lamps is shifting from voluntary to expected, and it doubles as a low-cost customer-loyalty hook.
adjacentServices: Duplicate key cutting on-site — a key-cutting machine pays for itself many times over on a closed campus of 5,000 where the nearest locksmith is 30-50 km away and hostel children lose keys constantly. Highest-value single service in this lane.
Trunk-and-locker lock fitting plus numbering at admission intake — a bundled service (lock + fit + engrave/number + spare key) sold to wardens per hostel block rather than to individual students.
In-store fitting and swap service: bulb, tube, batten, holder, plug top, tap washer and fan regulator changed on the spot or in the room for a small charge, with the dead unit taken in for disposal.
Battery and e-waste take-back bin — collect used dry cells, coin cells and dead LED lamps at the counter (EPR-aligned), which also brings the customer back into the store on a schedule.

On-call electrician and plumber booking desk, tied to campus maintenance staff — the store takes the job, supplies the parts and books the person. Converts a ₹30 washer into a ₹200 job and captures the whole repair.

Tool lending / deposit library — drill, ladder, spirit level, line tester, caulking gun issued against a refundable deposit. Nobody in a staff quarter needs to own a drill; the consumables (bits, wall plugs, screws) are where the money is.
Cut-to-length counter for house wire, flexible cord, nylon rope, clothesline wire, hose pipe, PVC pipe and tarpaulin — a service no coil-selling wholesaler offers and pure margin on the offcut.

Rechargeable torch, emergency light and power bank repair drop-off — mostly a dead Li-ion pack or a broken charging port; stock 18650 cells and Type-C sockets and turn a scrapped item into a ₹200-400 repair sale.

Winter kit pre-booking (September-October) — immersion rods, room heaters, geyser elements taken as pre-orders with part payment so the stock actually lands before the first cold snap instead of arriving in January.

Pre-monsoon leak-proofing bundle (April-June) — tarpaulin + rope + M-Seal + leak-seal tape + silicone + Dr Fixit sold as one kit to quarters and hostel blocks, marketed on a date rather than on demand.
LPG hose safety-check-and-replace drive — inspect ISI hose expiry in kitchens and quarters and replace on the spot; a genuine safety service in a residential institution and a clean recurring SKU.
Fire extinguisher refilling and smoke-alarm battery replacement contract for hostel blocks, kitchen and generator room — annual, institutional, invoiced to the Trust rather than to residents.

Institutional indent desk for wardens and the works department — a monthly indent sheet for bulbs, battens, tubes, fasteners, tapes and adhesives so campus consumption is forecast instead of firefought, with campus doorstep delivery for heavy items (tarpaulin, pipe, heaters, ladders).
